verdict.rationale: v0 lets users push generated code to GitHub or start from existing files, effectively letting them export the core artifact (code) in an open format and leave the platform (v0-docs-2, v0-docs-31, v0-docs-25). However there's no documented way to export other data like chat history, project settings, design tokens, or account data in an open format. Missing for 10: full account/chat/project data export, documented data-portability policy, and independent confirmation of a complete 'export and leave' workflow beyond code.
